about: Safety-check cases. 'prototype' cases are ported from the old guardrail_cases.py (22 escalate + 24 proceed), relabeled from A-E into the new categories by human judgment, not by what any rule outputs. None of these sentences may appear in the classifier prompt (a pytest checks this). Phase 6 runs them against the real model.
